card.title: 676th REGIMENT
card.text: Gains +2 attack and Shock every time it takes damage.
card.flavorText: The 676th Rifle Regiment was an infantry unit of the Soviet Red Army which was active during WWII. At the beginning of the war, it was part of the 192nd Mountain Rifle Division, serving under the 12th Army. By early August 1940, the 192nd Division was trapped in the German encirclement near Uman. All of the division, apart from the 676th Regiment, was destroyed. The regiment subsequently joined the 15th Rifle Division and participated in defending the Donbas area until being transferred to the Bryansk Front's 13th Army in May 1942. The 15th Rifle Division took part in the defensive battle at Voronezh in the summer of 1942 and in the subsequent Voronezh-Kastornoye offensive to liberate the city in early 1943. It was later involved in the Battle of Kursk, occupying a defensive position in the northern sector, and in a series of soviet offensive operations, notably Operation Bagration and the liberation of Baranovichi in 1944, the East Pomeranian Offensive and finally the Battle of Berlin in 1945. The 676th Rifle Regiment was awarded the Order of the Red Banner and the Order of Suvorov for its actions during the war.
